_note: PostHog changelog is rendered from Gatsby page-data. Probe found page-data/changelog/page-data.json, but the allRoadmap.nodes array is oldest-first and HTML repeating patterns are navigation/timeline buttons, causing title selector failures. Handwritten adapter reverses the JSON nodes so polling sees newest changelog items first. robots.txt only disallows markdown files for named bots; no Crawl-Delay. Adapter uses a conservative 5-8s polite sleep.
